name: Brooklands by Claude Bosi
address: The Peninsula Hotel, 1 Grosvenor Place, Belgravia, London, SW1X 7HJ
dinnerNote: Brooklands Seasonal tasting menu, 6 courses (vegetarian Brooklands Nature menu £205)

menus.name: Brooklands Seasonal tasting menu
menus.note: Pairing: The Aviator £165, or The Concorde £295. Optional cheese course £25–35.

menus.name: Brooklands Nature tasting menu
menus.note: Vegetarian. Same pairings as the Seasonal menu.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone or email (plnbrooklands@peninsula.com). Dinner is served Tuesday to Saturday, 6pm to 9:30pm.
cancellation: Bookings can be cancelled up to 48 hours ahead. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged £165 a person.
groups: The whole restaurant can be booked for up to 65 guests, and the Mach II private dining room seats up to 22. Enquiries to plnbrooklands@peninsula.com.
dressCode: Smart casual. No sportswear or baseball caps; men are encouraged to wear a collared shirt, and full-length trousers are required.
children: Children of all ages are welcome; let the restaurant know when booking.
